inputs.prompt: A single continuous low-angle shot in detailed gothic Japanese anime, exact supplied first image. At screen LEFT the little blue whale-cloak girl grips the tip of a log to block the black-gold robed acolyte at screen RIGHT. The acolyte impatiently pulls the log out of her hands, drawing it smoothly toward his own body at screen RIGHT. Both his hands stay on the wood. The girl tries to keep her grip, leans forward after the moving log, then her fingers slip off its end. Losing that support, she stumbles one short step forward to the RIGHT, her knees buckle and her weight drops straight DOWN. She catches herself on her palms and knees on the wet stone floor. Small low realistic fall, both boots close to the ground, no jumping or bouncing. Her hands visibly separate from the wood before she falls. She stays on the floor, lifts her worried face and reaches one hand after the departing acolyte. The acolyte holds the same log securely and steps toward the stairs at the BACK RIGHT. Clear cause and effect: pulling wood away, losing grip, knees folding, hands landing. Preserve exact same embroidered blue cloak and whale hood, white fur, blue boots, black-gold robe, log shape, stairs rising to the distant cross, blue stained windows and warm firelight. Locked camera and unchanged architecture. No face touching, no new people, no kick, no flying, no smile, no exaggerated cartoon physics, no cuts.
